review.eventDescription: One guest review of a Trip.com or Ctrip hotel: 0-10 rating (and out of 5) with four sub-scores, rating word, review text as written, language, recommend flag, review and check-in dates, room, travel type, reviewer name, country, level and review count, helpful votes, photos, source (Trip.com, Ctrip, Expedia, Hotels.com) and the hotel's reply with date (row keys rating, rating_5, rating_location, rating_facility, rating_service, rating_room, rating_text, text, language, recommend, review_date, check_in, room_type, travel_type, reviewer_name, reviewer_country, reviewer_level, reviewer_reviews, helpful_votes, images, source, response, response_date): $4 per 1,000 reviews. Not charged: hotel rows, status rows, reviews removed by maxRating or requireText, reviews Trip.com's language filter skips (never fetched), a hotel given twice (URL and id of one hotel are read once), hotels with no reviews, unknown ids, bad input. No start fee; proxy and compute are included in the event price. Trip.com pages 100 reviews at a time. The run stops at the maximum cost per run you set when starting it (Apify run option maxTotalChargeUsd), never above it.
